{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > /tmp/test_batch_writer.py << 'EOF'
import pytest
from copy import deepcopy
from tinydb import TinyDB, Query
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
from tinydb.journal import BatchWriter

@pytest.fixture
def pair():
    db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
    return (db, BatchWriter(db))

# R01 tests
def test_apply_insert(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    result = bw.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}])
    assert result == [1]
    assert db.all() == [{'doc_id': 1, 'x': 1}]

def test_apply_remove(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    result = bw.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 1}])
    assert result == []
    assert len(db) == 0

def test_apply_empty(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    assert bw.apply([]) == []

def test_apply_mixed(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    result = bw.apply([
        {'op': 'insert', 'document': {'y': 2}},
        {'op': 'insert', 'document': {'z': 3}},
        {'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 1},
    ])
    assert result == [1, 2]
    assert len(db) == 2

def test_apply_unknown_op(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        bw.apply([{'op': 'unknown'}])

def test_apply_malformed(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        bw.apply([{'op': 'insert'}])  # missing document

def test_apply_non_list(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        bw.apply('not a list')

# R02 tests
def test_apply_atomic_rollback(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        bw.apply([
            {'op': 'insert', 'document': {'y': 2}},
            {'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 99},  # missing
        ])
    assert len(db) == 1
    assert db.all()[0]['x'] == 1

def test_apply_remove_missing(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        bw.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 1}])

# R03 tests
def test_no_aliasing(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    doc = {'x': 1, 'nested': {'a': 1}}
    bw.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': doc}])
    doc['x'] = 999
    doc['nested']['a'] = 999
    assert db.all()[0]['x'] == 1
    assert db.all()[0]['nested']['a'] == 1

def test_mutate_op_after_apply(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    doc = {'x': 1}
    bw.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': doc}])
    doc['x'] = 999
    assert db.all()[0]['x'] == 1

def test_preexisting_docs(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    bw.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'y': 2}}])
    assert len(db) == 2

def test_empty_doc(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    assert bw.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {}}]) == [1]

# R04 tests
def test_bool_doc_id_rejected(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        bw.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': True}])

def test_bool_doc_id_not_accepted(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        bw.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': False}])

def test_non_dict_document_rejected(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        bw.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': 'not a dict'}])

def test_unsupported_fields(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        bw.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}, 'extra': 'field'}])

# R05 tests
def test_preview_no_change(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    assert bw.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]) == [1]
    assert len(db) == 0

def test_preview_on_error_returns_partial(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    # preview should return partial IDs even when batch would fail
    result = bw.preview([
        {'op': 'insert', 'document': {'y': 2}},
        {'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 99},  # would error
    ])
    assert result == [2]  # partial result, no error raised
    assert len(db) == 1  # no change

def test_preview_no_id_consumption(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    assert bw.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {}}]) == [1]
    assert bw.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {}}]) == [1]
    assert bw.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {}}]) == [1]
    assert bw.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {}}]) == [2]

# R06 tests
def test_direct_inserts_seen(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    assert bw.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {}}]) == [2]

def test_direct_inserts_between_apply(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    bw.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'a': 1}}])
    db.insert({'b': 2})
    result = bw.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'c': 3}}])
    assert len(db) == 3

# R07 tests
def test_idempotent_same_ops(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    ops = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]
    assert bw.apply(ops, token='t1') == [1]
    assert bw.apply(ops, token='t1') == [1]
    assert len(db) == 1

def test_idempotent_different_ops(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    ops1 = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]
    ops2 = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}}]
    bw.apply(ops1, token='t1')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        bw.apply(ops2, token='t1')
    assert len(db) == 1

def test_failed_batch_no_token(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        bw.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 99}], token='t1')
    assert 't1' not in bw.tokens

def test_invalid_token(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        bw.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}], token='')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        bw.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}], token=123)

# R08 tests
def test_preview_no_token_consumption(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    # preview should not accept token (original signature)
    assert bw.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]) == [1]
    assert 't1' not in bw.tokens

def test_return_list_no_internal_state(pair):
    db, bw = pair
    ops = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]
    result = bw.apply(ops, token='t1')
    assert isinstance(result, list)
    assert result == [1]

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pytest.main([__file__, '-v'])
